# Revcenter API

> Run candidate searches, read scored profiles and build shortlists from your own systems and AI tools.

Every page is also available as Markdown: add `.md` to its address. All pages in one file: https://docs.revcenter.ai/llms-full.txt

## Get started

- [Overview](https://docs.revcenter.ai/introduction.md): Run candidate searches, read scored profiles and build shortlists from your agent, terminal or apps.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.revcenter.ai/quickstart.md): From login to a scored shortlist with the revcenter CLI, or with curl.
- [Authentication](https://docs.revcenter.ai/authentication.md): API keys, the CLI's browser login, and how to give an agent access safely.

## Concepts

- [Execution model](https://docs.revcenter.ai/concepts/execution-model.md): The primitives Revcenter runs on, what each does, and which tools expose it.
- [CLI basics](https://docs.revcenter.ai/concepts/cli-basics.md): How the revcenter CLI logs in, where it keeps the key, what it prints, and how it exits.

## Tools

- [CLI reference](https://docs.revcenter.ai/tools/cli.md): Every revcenter command, its options, and whether it uses shortlist credits.
- [MCP](https://docs.revcenter.ai/tools/mcp.md): Use Revcenter as tools in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other MCP clients.
- [Agents](https://docs.revcenter.ai/tools/agents.md): Hand a search to an AI agent: setup, the workflow, and a prompt to start from.

## Guides

- [Criteria](https://docs.revcenter.ai/guides/criteria.md): What a search looks for: which fields filter LinkedIn before anything is read, and which score after.
- [Searches and shortlists](https://docs.revcenter.ai/guides/searches.md): How a search runs, what its outcome means, and how to get more people without starting over.
- [Rate limits](https://docs.revcenter.ai/guides/rate-limits.md): Request and search limits, the 429 response, and how to retry.
- [Errors](https://docs.revcenter.ai/guides/errors.md): The error shape, every code the API returns, and which requests are safe to retry.
- [Pagination](https://docs.revcenter.ai/guides/pagination.md): Cursor pagination on list endpoints, page sizes, and the deprecated offset.
- [Async jobs](https://docs.revcenter.ai/guides/async-jobs.md): Searches and expansions run in the background: how to wait and which statuses mean done.
- [Billing](https://docs.revcenter.ai/guides/billing.md): What uses a shortlist credit, and what is free.

## Recipes

- [Run a search and export the shortlist](https://docs.revcenter.ai/recipes/run-a-search.md): From criteria to a CSV shortlist with the revcenter CLI, with the output to expect at each step. Uses 1 shortlist credit.
- [Run a search from a coding agent](https://docs.revcenter.ai/recipes/coding-agent.md): Connect Claude Code or Codex, give the agent a brief, and check what it runs. Uses 1 shortlist credit.
- [Run a search from a backend job](https://docs.revcenter.ai/recipes/backend-job.md): A Node.js job that launches a search safely, waits for it, pages through the people and saves the shortlist CSV. Uses 1 shortlist credit.

## Use cases

- [Executive search sourcing](https://docs.revcenter.ai/use-cases/executive-search.md): Turn a mandate into criteria, run one search, and refine the slate without spending again.
- [Shortlist delivery to clients](https://docs.revcenter.ai/use-cases/client-shortlists.md): Keep a project's shortlist current from your own systems and deliver it as a CSV or through the app.
- [Agent-driven research](https://docs.revcenter.ai/use-cases/agent-research.md): Let an AI agent draft criteria, run a search and explain the results, with you approving each spend.

## API reference

- [API reference](https://docs.revcenter.ai/api-reference/introduction.md): The Revcenter HTTP API: base URL, request and response shape.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/health: Health. Whether the API is up. No key needed. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/auth/device: Start a device login. Start a device login, for a machine with no browser. Show the person verification_uri_complete and user_code, then poll POST /auth/token every interval seconds. No key needed. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/auth/token: Finish a login. Trade a sign-in for a key, returned once. A browser sign-in sends grant_type authorization_code with the code from the loopback redirect, its PKCE code_verifier and the same redirect_uri. A device login polls with device_code: authorization_pending (or slow_down) until someone authorizes it at /oauth/device. Errors: access_denied, expired_token, invalid_grant. No key needed. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/auth/revoke: Revoke this key. The key in the Authorization header revokes itself, as revcenter auth logout does. Answers revoked: false for a key that is already revoked or unknown. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/me: Who am I. The key's workspace, name, scopes and expiry, the workspace's plan and limits, and today's usage. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/me/usage: Today's usage. Today's requests and searches, and shortlist credits remaining. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/capacity: Live capacity. How busy Revcenter is right now: searches running and waiting across the platform and in this workspace, and about when a search launched now would start. Launches are never refused for being busy: a search past the platform's limit waits its turn (status queued) and starts as one finishes. Workspaces take turns, so a workspace with many searches waiting does not hold up another's first one. Use this to tell the person what to expect before launching many searches at once. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/billing/top-up: Buy more shortlist credits. A Stripe checkout link to add shortlist credits to this workspace at its plan's rate; open it to pay. Nothing is charged until someone pays on that page. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/actions: List actions. Every action this API offers, with its route, scope and cost class: the catalog the MCP tools are built from. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/actions/preview: Preview an action. What an action would do and spend, without doing it; returns a proposal_id that apply_proposal runs within 30 minutes. Works for every action marked proposable in GET /actions. Previewing a requirement change re-scores nothing until it is applied, except that its before/after is computed on the people already read. Previewing launch_search with criteria returns compiled_query: the exact titles, keyword terms, locations, level, years and employers the search will send. page_one_estimate is null in a preview (reading page 1 is paid); the search records it once it runs. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/proposals/apply: Apply a proposal. Run an action previewed with preview_action, exactly as previewed. Applying the same proposal twice returns the first result. The key needs the scope of the action the proposal runs, too. Uses what its preview stated: 1 shortlist credit for a search or an expansion, nothing for anything else.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/reference/criteria: Criteria reference. Every criteria field, whether it filters LinkedIn before anything is bought or scores after, its allowed values, and an example. Read it before launch_search. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/reference/industries: Find industries. LinkedIn industries matching a word, with their ids; use the labels in current_industries and exclude_industries. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects: List projects. The workspace's projects, newest first, with how many searches each ran and how many are on its shortlist. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects: Create a project. Make a project: one role, one shortlist. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}: Get a project. One project, with its search and shortlist counts. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}/searches: List a project's searches. The searches a project has run, oldest first. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}/searches: Launch a search. Start a LinkedIn search in a project, on `criteria` run exactly as sent, or on a `jd_text` Revcenter reads; with database_only it scores the workspace's candidates on file and uses no credit. Send an Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key, project and body returns the same search; the same key on a different request returns 409 idempotency_key_reused. Uses 1 shortlist credit.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/searches/{searchId}: Get a search. A search's status, stage, outcome (Shortlist ready, Poor yield, No results) and how many profiles it read; poll until status is no longer queued or running. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/searches/{searchId}/cancel: Cancel a search. Stop a running search: it buys nothing more, scores what it already read, and keeps them. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/searches/{searchId}/people: List scored people. Everyone a search scored, best first: score, fit readings, signals, whether they are on the shortlist, and the whole read profile. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}/expand: Expand a search. A live LinkedIn pass for more people on the same role, skipping everyone already found; at most 2 per project. Uses 1 shortlist credit.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/searches/{searchId}/scoring/preview: Preview a scoring change. What a cut-off, weight or requirement change would do to the shortlist, before and after; changes nothing. Re-scores the people already found. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/searches/{searchId}/scoring/apply: Apply a scoring change. Apply a cut-off, weight or requirement change: everyone already read is re-scored and the shortlist moves. Re-scores the people already found. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/searches/{searchId}/database-pass: Search your database again. Score the workspace's candidates on file against this search; those who clear the bar join the shortlist. Re-scores the people already found. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}/shortlist: Get the shortlist. Everyone on the project's live shortlist, best first, with full profiles. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}/shortlist.csv: Download the shortlist CSV. The shortlist as CSV: every profile field, and the profile as JSON in the last column. Does not use shortlist credits.
- POST https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}/shortlist/members: Add to the shortlist. Put people the project's searches found on its shortlist, by candidate id (from list_people). Does not use shortlist credits.
- DELETE https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/projects/{projectId}/shortlist/members/{candidateId}: Remove from the shortlist. Take someone off the shortlist, with an optional reason. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/candidates: List the candidate database. Everyone any of this workspace's searches found, newest first, as the Candidates tab lists them; filter by text, project, title, company or place. Does not use shortlist credits.
- GET https://api.revcenter.ai/v1/candidates.csv: Download the candidate database CSV. The candidate database as CSV (up to 5,000 people, the same filters as list_candidates): every profile field, and the profile as JSON in the last column. Does not use shortlist credits.
- [OpenAPI document](https://docs.revcenter.ai/openapi.json): the whole API, machine-readable
